provenance.source: Codigo do IRS artt. 25, 68 e 68-A; Orcamento do Estado 2026; PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Portugal; PwC Portugal Guia Fiscal 2026 (seguranca social)
provenance.notes: The nine 2026 brackets with their parcela a abater came from PwC on 31 August 2026, as did the solidarity surcharge. The 11% employee social security rate came from PwC Portugal's Guia Fiscal 2026.

verificationTodo: specificDeduction.floor is derived from 8.54 x IAS and has not been confirmed for 2026. It matters for everyone earning under about EUR 40,000.
Confirm the minimo de existencia for 2026, which this app does not apply at all.
omissions: The minimo de existencia, which exempts low incomes entirely, is not modelled, so low incomes are overstated.
IRS Jovem, the reduced regime for young workers, is not modelled.
Deducoes a coleta for health, education, housing and general family expenses are not modelled.
Only single taxpayers without dependants are modelled; joint taxation is out of scope.

scale.note: Portugal states each band as a rate plus a parcela a abater, a fixed amount subtracted from rate x income. That is arithmetically the same as marginal bands, but it is how the statute is written and how a Portuguese payslip explains it.

specificDeduction.note: Category A income gets a specific deduction equal to the higher of a fixed floor and your actual social security contributions, so most employees deduct the floor.

socialSecurity.note: A flat 11% with no ceiling. The employer pays a further 23.75%.

solidarity.note: An additional rate on high incomes, charged on the excess over each threshold.

regions.name: Portugal continental
regions.note: The Azores and Madeira apply reduced rates that this version does not model.

inputSchema.label: Remuneracao bruta (per month)
inputSchema.help: Gross monthly pay. Add the subsidio de ferias and subsidio de Natal to the months in which they are paid.

inputSchema.label: Retencao na fonte de IRS (per month)
inputSchema.help: IRS withheld each month, for the annual comparison.

inputSchema.label: Contribuicoes para PPR
inputSchema.help: Retirement savings plan contributions. In Portugal these give a credit against the tax rather than a deduction from income; this app treats the amount you enter as a credit at 20%, capped at EUR 400.
